messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT — Canary wave 3 (us-west-2) showing elevated 5xx rate: 4.8% over 5m > threshold 3.0%. Rolling window: 5m. Auto-abort policy is ENABLED but not yet tripped. https://dash.internal/redwood/canaries

alice.dev: seeing same on flame graph, traces show increased 5xx from model-serving pod group canary-3

alice.dev: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:02:12Z model-serving canary-3 500 "kv-cache-miss"
2026-03-17T10:02:18Z model-serving canary-3 502 "gpu-oom-retry"
2026-03-17T10:03:01Z model-serving canary-3 503 "stream-reset"
```

ben_oncall: @alice.dev thanks. Is the abort missing because we allowed a manual window?

alice.dev: auto-abort param was 6m consecutive breach, we hit 5m so it's close but not yet.

incident-bot: PAGED ben_oncall (on-call) — Severity: P2. Accept with `ack` to start mitigation.

ben_oncall: ack. I'm joining. First priority: protect production traffic.

ben_oncall: lina_support can you check if any customer-facing incidents reported?

lina_support: checked support queue — one ticket from ACME about a transient 502 on ingestion. No active SLO breach alerts yet.

charlie_sre: quick ask — can we flip the canary kill-switch/flag for wave 3 to prevent further traffic? What's the feature flag id?

alice.dev: flag is ff_canary_us_west_v3. Command to flip:
```bash
curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/ff_canary_us_west_v3/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN"
```

ben_oncall: doing the disable now.

ben_oncall: DISABLE command issued -> flag state: disabled :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: action: traffic-steer -> fallback-route (stable model) completed. approx 18% of traffic removed from canary targets.

alice.dev: verify metrics — starting to see 5xx rate drop in the next sample window.

incident-bot: Reminder — create incident ticket if mitigation changes config.

ben_oncall: creating INC-2026-234 in tracker with current notes, assigning to charlie_sre for follow-up and RCA.

charlie_sre: taking handoff. I'll collect core dumps and q-dispatch logs from canary nodes, suspect KV cache eviction path.

maria_pm: any customer scope? ACME ticket id 789 — please ping if they ask. I'll draft status note if we escalate.

alice.dev: after flag disable, 5xx dropped to 0.9% over 5m. Latency back to baseline. No additional errors in other regions.

ben_oncall: rolling back canary deployment for wave 3 as a precaution (rollback id: rb-4789123456). Initiating now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started, wave: 3 -> target stable image, expects 6 min to converge.

ben_oncall: monitoring...

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully. Healthchecks green.

lina_support: updated ACME ticket with mitigation note. No customer escalation needed.

charlie_sre: collecting artifacts; will open postmortem outline and tag with INC-2026-234. Initial hypothesis: regression in kv-cache eviction under certain token lengths causing intermittent stream resets -> reproducing locally now.

ben_oncall: handing off to charlie_sre for full RCA and long-term fix. I'm un-acking at 10:31 UTC. Great job, team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigation succeeded). Please file postmortem link in INC-2026-234 within 72h.
